about: Where each section of Calvin's commentary on this book starts and ends in the chapter text (character offsets into library/commentary/Calvin/ZEP.json), and which verse it opens on. Built from CCEL's own section markers by tools/build-calvin-index.py. No text is copied. "span" gives the verses a section covers: from Calvin's own heading where there is one, otherwise "next section" (every verse up to the next commented verse). Several sections may open on the same verse; read all. "unplaced" lists CCEL sections we could not find in our text. "head" is the first 30 characters of the section, to catch an offset that has moved. Overview and sections together cover the whole chapter text, apart from the white space between them. A chapter entry is valid only for the text whose sha256 it records.
